Suniel Shetty's granddaughter faces online backlash after 'pro-Modi' remark

Actor Suniel Shetty shared an anecdote about his 15-month-old granddaughter, Evaarah, offering a 'laddoo' to Prime Minister Narendra Modi, which he described as a morning ritual. This remark, made two days prior, led to significant online backlash directed at both Shetty and his granddaughter. The incident highlights the polarized nature of online discourse surrounding political figures in India.
